note.label: Making Our Face Harder Than Their Face

precepts.why:
“The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.” That is what you see our leadership doing today: prophesying against many kingdoms, of war, of evil and of pestilence.

And what happened to the prophets of old who did that? “They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me. Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.” That is our forefather Jeremiah in the dungeon, in the pit, the dungeon where there was no water but mire and he sunk in it, for warning the king. We all have to go through that. Write that precept down.

So we do not stop. We are on the quest, in Ecuador, in Haiti, in Puerto Rico, going to different countries, because this gospel cannot be stopped; the mission must continue. “The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that the Lord hath truly sent him.” We have been warning this country and our brothers over and over of what is coming. Those who take heed will show that this prophet was among us doing his job, and that is what you are beginning to see now. So we continue the mission, continually hardening our faces against the wicked, even if it leads to the dungeon.

precepts.point: Hated of all nations for the black Messiah, not white Jesus; the Christians' faces change when you say Christ is black, and we cannot be ashamed to confess it. Then many shall be offended and betray one another; your oppressor is the villain, and all nations saved means the other nations still rule over you.
precepts.why:
We are living in a very precious time. The Holy Spirit is on the prophets of God; they see what is going on, correlate it with the scriptures, and edification goes out so we can all acknowledge that this Bible is a true book and that God controls everything. When wars and rumours of wars are shown against the scriptures, that is prophesying, and it is something the prophets have always done.

“The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.” Even the prophets before Jeremiah prophesied against many countries and great kingdoms: of war, which is what we see going on now; of evil; and of pestilence. Behind war comes pestilence.

That lines up with Matthew 24: “nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences”. The black men in purple and gold on the streets, correlating these wars with the scriptures and teaching with authority, are doing what the prophets of old did.

So do not be troubled by the wars, and do not get relaxed. Famine comes from lack of fuel, farm equipment that cannot run, and trucks that cannot haul livestock. Prepare.

precepts.why:
Jeremiah says the prophets of old “prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.” All the prophets made sure to speak of these things. It is bad news for everybody else but good news for Israel, because when we see these signs we see the time hastening for the Lord's people, his heritage. They are not uncertain; they are an assurance and an establishment of our faith. This is not a time to prophesy peace in the earth. The peace is among us: the middle wall of partition broken down between the northern and southern kingdom, no more alienation from Christ, his laws and our identity.

Isaiah tells us where to see it: “Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate”. We must read and understand so we can see these things. Too many of our people, even those repenting, are caught up in other things and do not think what is happening warrants their attention. Go back and read your scriptures more. The warnings and the shortening of days are there to put a fire under us so we seek out our own salvation with fear and trembling.

No other book gives this understanding. It has survived countless attempts to burn, destroy and alter it, and Christianity minimizes it to a book of love, hugs and kisses. That is a slap in the face, because most of the book is doom, destruction, war, judgment and recompense, and the people waiting on prophecy are always the oppressed.

“for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.” Christ's spirit gathered these things together so they would be plain to those who keep the commandments and be preserved for us to use in these last days. None of the prophecies of war, evil and pestilence will fail.

“The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.” That's what we do in the streets, teaching against what America taught us and warning of this place's destruction. Christians aren't on the corners saying it will end. They call that radical behavior now, but it's what the prophets always did.

America, the Crusades, coming here to enslave, murder, rape, and rob a country—that's radical behavior. When it's our turn to establish our kingdom, it's a problem. I'm not talking about raping or doing that. There's no revolution without bloodshed; we just have to wait on Christ. Lord, burn this thing up. Bring it down. If that's what it's called, sign me up.

points: Because our job in bringing this rumour out is to prophesy about destruction. It is to prophesy about what they do not want taught. It is to bring out the fact that they are Edom. That they are Esau. That they are the wicked that the Bible talks about. The Bible says, and then shall that Wicked be revealed. How is he going to be revealed? Going back to what my brother pointed out: because we have to reveal him. So the objective is to keep us from revealing him, because as long as people can think that he is Jesus Christ, think that he is the Jews, think that he is the Christians and all that, they are going to continue to be here doing their evil and mischief.

The Lord says it is time for them to come down now. It is time for my prophets to let the whole planet earth know that these are the demons. And it is time for my prophets to be exalted, to be lifted up, to be raised up, because their kingdom is coming. So as our kingdom is coming, you know that persecution is coming our way. You know that the hatred is going to get ramped up. You know that it is going to be some serious business out here. So we better really come together like that Bible says, on the real strength. Because the more that this Bible comes out, the harder it is going to get out here.

That is the reason why the black preachers are mad, because they say, you are messing it up for me. That is the reason why, when we teach our people in the street, they say, I do not want to hear about that Bible. Some of your mothers and fathers do not want to hear about the Bible. Some of your wives do not want to hear about the Bible. Some of your husbands do not want to hear about the Bible, because they know that that is going to cause a stir. That is going to bring division. Like Christ said, I have come to bring division. I am coming to stir things up. So they know that that is a problem. So we better be ready for it. The trees are unfurling.

The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence. So here you have the prophet Jeremiah going out in front of the Israelites telling them that, listen, not only am I going to prophesy about destruction and war, but the prophets that have come before me, that came before you, prophesied the same thing. Which means we are going to be doing the same thing as well. But every time this comes around we get closer and closer to our kingdom.

Now, the things that we are seeing today, we were not seeing those things back during the times when these things were being said and written. But we are in that time now, because Esau and Jacob is on the rise. That whole dynamic is in our face now. That was not the case back during the time of Rome. That was not the case during the time of Jeremiah. That was not the case of Isaiah. It did not happen like that then. We were still learning about prophecies that had to come to pass that had not even come to pass yet. We were looking for Christ to take us to our kingdom. That is what the apostles were saying: Art thou at this time come to restore the kingdom? And Christ told them, no, this ain't it. In another part, in Thessalonians, he said, no, this ain't the time, you have to completely fall. He says that day shall not come except there come a falling away first. So we had to go completely down. Now we are in the time now. Now this is super relevant.

So we prophesied about war. And of evil. That is what we are doing now. We are bringing it out. They do not want to hear this. And of pestilence. And of sicknesses and pestilence. All kinds of things are happening now, because our people are still playing with sin. Our people are still playing with evil, lying, deceit. So they have to hear that the Most High is about to bring judgment.

note.label: Raising Cain: The Son of Perdition, Merchants, and Captive Nations

points: In the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah, in the fifth month, Hananiah the son of Azur, a prophet of Gibeon, spake in the house of the Lord before the priests and all the people.

This so-called prophet spoke the things he claimed the Most High was going to do: that He had broken the yoke of the king of Babylon and within two full years would bring back the vessels of the Lord's house and Jeconiah with all the captives of Judah.
Jeremiah answered Amen, the Lord do so, the Lord perform thy words to bring again the vessels and the captives; but he told Hananiah not to hold on to that.

The prophets before them prophesied of war, of evil, and of pestilence, nothing of peace; so when a prophet prophesies peace, only when the word comes to pass is that prophet known to be truly sent of the Lord, and if it does not come to pass, the Lord is not working with him.
Hananiah took the yoke from off Jeremiah's neck, the yoke he wore in his captivity, and broke it before all the people.
He said thus saith the Lord, even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within two full years; and Jeremiah went his way.
The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah: thou hast broken the yokes of wood, but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron.

The Most High had put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who was the superpower at this time, and He gave him the beasts of the field also.
Jeremiah told Hananiah the Lord had not sent him, but he made the people trust in a lie and was leading his people astray.

Because he taught rebellion against the Lord, teaching the people to go against the Most High instead of accepting that they had to go through captivity, the Lord would cast him from off the face of the earth and he would die that year; Hananiah died the same year in the seventh month.
